title: content/exercise-motion.json
description: Own joint keyframes per exercise, made from our own filmed clips (issue #1069). A frame is 57 numbers: x, y, z of the 19 joints in the order of `joints`. Units are body heights (the figure is 1.0 tall); x is the figure's left, y is up, z is forward; y = 0 is the lowest point of any joint over the whole clip (x-floor-tolerance) and the ankle midpoint of each frame is at x = z = 0. tools/validate/exercise-motion.mjs enforces this and the rules JSON Schema cannot state (every key is an exercise in exercises.json, bone lengths within x-bone-tolerance of the skeleton table, the clip's lowest point within x-floor-tolerance of 0, a loop closes, unique source and clip ids, entry size).

joints.description: The 19 joints, in the order a frame lists them.

motions.description: Keyed by exercise name as in exercises.json. Empty until clips have been filmed, reviewed and signed off.

fps.description: Playback rate; the player interpolates between keyframes.

loop.description: True when the last frame leads back into the first without a jump.

source.description: Own filming only. The video is never shipped, only these joint numbers.

clip_id.description: Id of the source clip in the owner's clip register (outside the repo).

release_id.description: Id of the signed model release for the person filmed.

tools.description: Pipeline version, pose model name and its sha256.
